subject: general
question: The world's highest motorable road passes through ______ pass in India, as of 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __Umling La__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Umling La:

 
 
• In Ladakh, India, close to Demchok, on the ridgeline between Koyul Lungpa and the Indus River, lies a mountain pass known as Umling La.
 
• Umling Pass was awarded the Guinness World Record in 2021 for being the world's highest motorable road.​
